description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against tables staged on a DataCanvas by openmeteo_get_forecast, openmeteo_get_historical, openmeteo_get_marine, openmeteo_get_air_quality, openmeteo_get_ensemble, openmeteo_get_flood, or openmeteo_get_climate. Pass the canvas_id returned when any of those tools spills (truncated: true), and reference the exact table_name those tools return alongside it. Call openmeteo_dataframe_describe to list staged tables and their columns when you need to discover names.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by openmeteo_get_forecast, openmeteo_get_historical, openmeteo_get_marine, openmeteo_get_air_quality, openmeteo_get_ensemble, openmeteo_get_flood, or openmeteo_get_climate when truncated: true.

sql.description: Read-only SELECT statement. Reference table names from openmeteo_dataframe_describe. Example: SELECT AVG(temperature_2m) AS avg_temp, strftime(time, '%Y-%m') AS month FROM spilled_abc123 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

name: openmeteo_dataframe_query

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_not_enabled`: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE is not set to duckdb. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id is unknown or has expired under its 24 h sliding TTL. `system_catalog_access`: The SQL references a system catalog such as information_schema, sqlite_master, pg_catalog, or a duckdb_*() function. `missing_table`: The SQL references a table that is not staged on this canvas — a mistyped name, or one that expired (24 h sliding TTL) or was dropped. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

row_count.description: Total rows in the full result before any cap.

rows.description: Result rows — a preview capped at 100. When row_count exceeds this, page the rest by re-issuing the SQL with LIMIT / OFFSET.

title: Openmeteo Dataframe Query
